summary.benchmarkTitle: 2026 Top 100 AI Startups TLD Adoption, .ai vs .com & Aftermarket Availability Benchmark
summary.methodology: Live read-only DNS NS/A resolution (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 & Google 8.8.8.8) across 5 core startup TLDs (.com, .ai, .io, .dev, .app) + non-intrusive HTTPS Location header inspection on exact-match .com/.ai siblings.
